summary: Preserve evidence: place immediate legal hold and suspend automated deprovisioning for employee under HR review
description:
Issue summary: HR has initiated an internal conduct review for employee E-3284. Legal has requested preservation of all artifacts (Slack messages, console audit logs, S3 buckets, device disk images, and Git activity) and a suspension of any automated deprovisioning or credential rotation that would remove access or erase evidence.

Requested action: 1) Apply a legal hold to the account and related service principals. 2) Pause any scheduled deprovisioning jobs, automated device wipes, and external device return workflows for this subject. 3) Snapshot relevant logs and S3 objects pending forensics. 4) Notify SRE, IAM, Device Management, and Security that the user is in legal hold status.

Context: HR ticket HR-2026-145 opened 2026-03-09 (escalation after employee put on administrative leave). Standard offboarding automation would run in ~48 hours; we need to stop that clock and gather artifacts for Legal/HR.
impact: Potential deletion of audit trails, rotation of credentials, or remote wipe of hardware would destroy evidence required for HR + Legal review. Risk of non-compliance with internal investigation protocols and losing disciplinary evidence.
steps_to_reproduce: N/A - procedural request; not a reproducible bug. Steps documented for engineering action below.
investigation_notes: 2026-03-10 09:20 - Confirmed user E-3284 had active sessions in console and active Git pushes within last 24h (git server: git.redwood.internal).
2026-03-10 10:05 - Audit pipeline found scheduled offboarding job OFFBOARD-CRON-14 targeting service-account bindings and device-wipe tag for the user - set to run 2026-03-12 03:00 UTC.

2026-03-10 10:30 - Device Management inventory shows two devices registered: laptop LPT-5512 (company SSD encrypted) and loaner GPU node reservation GPU-09. Both show 'scheduled return' flags tied to offboarding automation.
2026-03-10 11:00 - Slack retention policy may auto-expunge messages older than 90 days; legal requested export of all channels where user posted between 2025-09-01 and 2026-03-09.
2026-03-11 14:15 - Forensics queue capacity flagged; requested expedited snapshot for related S3 buckets containing project artifacts (s3://projects/e3284-archive/).
2026-03-12 08:40 - IAM logs confirm no credential rotation yet; backups of access-keys scheduled daily. Legal asked to preserve last 90 days of key usage logs.
comments: Maya Thompson (2026-03-10 09:05): Opening ticket per HR request. HR contact: Lauren Kim. Legal contact: Priya Desai. Please take immediate action to block automation and notify Security.
Diego Ramirez (2026-03-10 09:18): Acknowledged. Will pause scheduled offboarding jobs and add "legal-hold" tag to user account. ETA 30m.

Security (A. Lopez) (2026-03-10 09:32): Confirmed procedure in runbook 'legal-hold-playbook-v2' https://confluence.redwood/legal/holds. Recommend creating isolated copy of affected S3 buckets to s3://forensics-staging/.

Device Management (K. Nguyen) (2026-03-10 09:50): Marked devices LPT-5512 and GPU-09 as 'do-not-wipe' and disabled remote wipe. Inventory snapshot taken and uploaded to confluence: /devices/e3284-inventory-20260310.
Forensics (J. Patel) (2026-03-11 14:30): Queued disk image capture for LPT-5512; ETA 2026-03-12 02:00 UTC. Requested elevated S3 read to pull project artifacts.

Diego Ramirez (2026-03-12 08:42): Offboarding cron OFFBOARD-CRON-14 paused at 2026-03-10 09:50. Legal hold tag present on account. Backups and last 90 days of IAM logs exported to secure bucket s3://forensics-hold/E-3284/.
Priya Desai (Legal) (2026-03-12 09:05): Received confirmation and artifacts. Legal holds and chain-of-custody notes required. Please include MD5 checksums for each artifact and access log export.
resolution: Partial mitigation completed on 2026-03-12: offboarding automation paused, devices marked do-not-wipe, initial disk image and S3 snapshot completed and uploaded to forensics staging. Next steps: 1) Provide checksums and chain-of-custody documentation (Forensics). 2) Freeze any credential rotation until Legal lifts the hold. 3) HR to confirm retention window and when it's safe to resume standard offboarding workflow. Ticket remains open until Legal closes the hold.
